description: DH.85 flown by J R D Tata on the 1962 re-enactment of his 1932 Karachi-Bombay airmail flight; preserved inside the Aero Club of India building next to the DGCA office at Safdarjung (WBI, 2006 report). Currency not re-verified since; indoors, access by arrangement.
